description: Search the library of nearly a thousand works by title, author, translator, blurb or group: Homer, Plato, Thucydides, Plutarch, Virgil, Livy and the rest of the Greek and Latin classics in the original beside English; the Pali Canon; Dostoevsky, Tolstoy, Pushkin in Russian; Camus, Kafka, Goethe; Philo, Josephus, the Mishnah in Hebrew and English, 1-3 Enoch, Jubilees, the Church Fathers, Aquinas, Calvin, Kierkegaard, Nietzsche... To find a passage inside a work, use read_work with find.

group.description: Optional group filter, e.g. "Hidden books", "Rabbinic", "Church Fathers", "Commentaries"
